value.rationale: Identifies a mathematically natural complete invariant for all formulas of the 2026 constructive two-modal semantics on finite chains. Provides the exact parametrized quotient size and an optimal constant-two local representation, reducing enormous neighbourhood-family choices to two independent monotone sequences. This is a structural model-compression and classification theorem, not only a short arithmetic corollary or arbitrary data point.
